summary:
FarmerX is an innovative agricultural project that aims to help farmers make better decisions by using NASA satellite and Earth observation data. The project combines data from NASA SMAP, IMERG, MODIS NDVI and NASA POWER to monitor soil moisture, rainfall, vegetation conditions, temperature and sunlight.
FarmerX aims to provide simple and useful recommendations based on the farmer’s location. These recommendations include planting guidance, irrigation awareness, crop rotation planning and alerts about possible dry or hot conditions.
The project also includes research through an interview with Ahmet Korhan Çiçek, a plant and flower grower and project advisor, to understand practical agricultural needs. Our main goal is to transform complex space-based data into accessible information that supports farmers and encourages more sustainable agricultural practices.Ali Atakul,AtaPrime
details:
Project Information – FarmerX

FarmerX is an agricultural technology project designed to help farmers make smarter and more informed decisions using NASA Earth observation data.

Farmers often face challenges such as changing weather conditions, water shortages and uncertainty about the best planting periods. FarmerX aims to address these problems by combining NASA datasets, including SMAP for soil moisture, GPM IMERG for rainfall, MODIS NDVI for vegetation monitoring and NASA POWER for weather and solar data.

By using the farmer's field location, FarmerX aims to provide easy-to-understand agricultural guidance, including planting recommendations, irrigation awareness, crop rotation planning and alerts about potentially dry or hot conditions.

The project has also been informed by an interview with Ahmet Korhan Çiçek, a plant and flower grower and project advisor. Our goal is to transform complex satellite data into practical information that can support sustainable agriculture and make technology more accessible to farmers.

Project Name: FarmerX
Team Name: AtaPrime
